name: resolve
assumes: NetNameIndex.resolve(input) for a name a tool caller passes
ws_matches counts nets other than the input itself whose whitespace-free key equals the input's key (block keys included)
trunc_matches counts nets, outside ws_matches, with a key over 31 characters starting with the input or its trimmed form, when that is exactly 31 characters
the NC placeholder is excluded from ws and trunc matching
